text:
alex: Heads-up — doing a short run of entitlement handbacks for stale admin roles this week. Planning to auto-propose owners for anything without a recent approver (30+ days).
maria: 👍 what's the threshold for 'stale'? 30 days is pretty tight for some teams.
dylan: prefer 90 days for product infra, 30 for critical kms/admin roles. Maybe tiered policy?
jenna: agreed. Suggest: 30d for org-admins/KMS, 60d for service accounts, 90d for project-level editors.
running: access-bot: Automated scan complete. Found 48 accounts with admin-like entitlements, 12 without an owner tag. See /scans/2026-03-admin-handback.csv
alex: thanks bot. @maria @dylan can you triage the 12 ownerless ones? focus on any linked to KMS or cross-account keys.
maria: started list — two are svcacct@analytics that call kms:Decrypt, no owner. I'll reach out to data-platform.
dylan: I pulled the audit logs for the last 90 days: three of the ownerless had recent activity, looks like automation. I'll add notes.
kai: FYI, if we revoke entitlements immediately some automation jobs will break. Can we do a staged handback: proposal -> 7d owner review -> revoke?
jenna: yes staged makes sense. Also add a fallback allowlist for infra-runbooks for 14 days while owners respond.
alex: plan: 1) propose handback for ownerless (no action yet) 2) send notices to last-modifier and team alias 3) 7d SLA for claim/assign 4) revoke with audit and KMS key rotation if entitlement was admin.
maria: outcomes we should record in audit log: proposer, assigned owner, revoke timestamp, justification. We should write a short template note for teams.
dylan: template draft: "Detected admin entitlement without owner. Please assign an owner or justify continued access. Lack of response will trigger handback and potential key rotation"
jenna: add link to quick remediation runbook and one-click owner assignment UI. Also include contact for emergency re-elevations.
kai: regarding KMS — if we revoke an admin that was used to rotate keys, we must ensure key rotation automation has a service principal. Let's add a pre-check: for any entitlement tied to kms:Manage or kms:Encrypt, ensure alternate principal exists.
alex: good catch. Add to the runbook pre-check step: "verify key rotation principal or schedule rotation after owner confirmation".
access-bot: Reminder scheduled: owner-proposal notifications will go out 2026-03-22T09:00Z.
maria: I'll start the outreach messages now to data-platform and infra.
dylan: I'll open an incident-ish thread if any automation breaks post-revoke so we can triage quickly.
jenna: can we add an optional canary revoke for low-risk accounts (1 account per team) to validate the flow?
alex: yes — enable canary where teams opt-in. Document that in the policy.
maria: ok, pinging teams + creating tickets. I'll post updates in #eng-oncall if any immediate fallout.
alex: thanks all. Will follow up with a short post-mortem template after the run completes. :thumbsup:
